# oko — BDIX Browser (Full Documentation)

## What is oko?
oko is a free BDIX browser for Android: browse and stream movies, TV shows and live TV from BDIX FTP servers in Bangladesh. One app for mobile & Android TV. No account needed; supported by ads via Google AdMob.

## How it Works
BDIX networks in Bangladesh expose local FTP media servers with movies, series and live TV. When on a supported BDIX ISP, oko browses those servers and streams in-app — faster and cleaner than a generic web browser.

## Platform Support
- **Mobile**: Android 5.0 (Lollipop) and above
- **Android TV**: same app, TV-friendly navigation
- Package: com.okoplayer.app, version 1.0.0

## Features
- BDIX browsing: movies, TV shows, live TV
- Multi-source server support
- Lightweight, fast, minimal interface
- No account required
- Watch history, settings and downloads stay on-device

## Requirements
- Android 5.0+ phone or Android TV
- Connection to a supported BDIX ISP in Bangladesh

## Privacy
No account. Google AdMob may collect device information and ad identifiers to serve ads. Local data (watch history, settings, downloads) never leaves the device. Details: https://mahidsec.github.io/oko/privacy-policy/
